description:
Check a checkout session once. The server reconciles with the payment provider on every call, so this resolves even when webhooks are late.

Args:
  - session_id: from jami_create_checkout.

Returns: { session_id, status: 'open' | 'completed' | 'expired', order_id, order_status, amount_minor, amount, expires_at, failure }.
When status is 'expired', failure.code explains why: payment_rejected · payment_failed · payment_canceled · payment_timed_out · initiate_failed · session_expired.

Use jami_wait_for_checkout instead if you want to block until the buyer finishes.

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for a readable summary, 'json' for the full structured payload

session_id.description: Checkout session id returned by jami_create_checkout, e.g. "6710c2e8b1a2f0012ab34cd9"

name: jami_get_checkout_status

failure.description: Why the session ended without an order; null unless status is "expired"

title: Get checkout status
